GROUNDED ANSWER

Reserve requirements for a second home

● Source-backed

For a second-home transaction, both agencies require financial reserves in addition to funds needed to close. The amount depends on the number of financed properties the borrower owns and the loan’s DU/LPA evaluation.

↗

Practical read: Start with the AUS findings. If the borrower has other financed properties, expect additional reserve requirements tied to those properties.

This research summary is not an underwriting decision. Confirm the current guide and your AUS findings before approving a loan.
